      Sets the tile-generation worker count for subsequent createImage(s) calls on this instance.

    • createImage

      public Path createImage(ImageInfo imageInfo, Path outputDir, TileSink sink) throws Exception
      Generates tiles and info.json, merging the sink's TileSink.InfoExtension into the document.

      The extension is resolved before tiling so incompatible combinations (e.g. C2PA trust-anchor with Image API 2, which has no place for namespaced properties) fail fast without writing tiles.

      Throws:
      Exception

    • enrichMetadata

      protected static Map<String,Object> enrichMetadata(ImageInfo imageInfo, int x, int y, int w, int h, int scale)
      Builds the per-tile metadata map: a copy of the source metadata with the tile's region recorded in source-image coordinates (iiif.region.* keys, used by the C2PA and UltraHDR sinks).
      Parameters:
      imageInfo - The image info (source and primary dimensions).
      x - Tile region X in source-image pixels.
      y - Tile region Y in source-image pixels.
      w - Tile region width in source-image pixels.
      h - Tile region height in source-image pixels.
      scale - Scale factor (1 = full resolution).
      Returns:
      A new map with the region keys applied.

    • attachHdrMetadata

      protected static void attachHdrMetadata(ImageInfo imageInfo, TileSink sink, Map<String,Object> meta)
      Attaches the source HDR frame to the per-tile metadata map when the sink opted into HDR (TileSink.supportsHdr()) and the source offers the HdrSource capability.

      The payload materializes only here — sinks that do not opt in never pay for HDR decoding. Failures degrade to SDR tiling (logged) instead of failing the tile.

      Parameters:
      imageInfo - The image info (source and primary dimensions).
      sink - The tile sink about to receive the tile.
      meta - The per-tile metadata map to extend in place.
